title: Spotify Listening Habits and Top Artists
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player/achievements (`steam:player`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and the *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=spotify:play
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(duration_ms) as ms, dc(track_id) as unique_tracks by artist _time
| eval minutes=round(ms/60000)
| sort - minutes
| head 20
description: Builds your own monthly listening wrap-up ranking your top artists and how much you explored, without waiting for a year-end summary.
value: A personal, always-on listening summary is more fun and honest than a once-a-year recap and helps you notice music ruts.
implementation: Ingest Spotify recently-played into `index=personal`; schedule monthly and enjoy your own listening wrap-up.
visualization: Bar chart of monthly listening minutes by artist.
grandmaExplanation: It builds your own music summary each month, showing your favourite artists and how much you listened.
